airfoil_rans_cst_re4e6.title: Airfoil RANS campaign, CST shapes, Re 4e6 (OpenFOAM, k-omega SST)
airfoil_rans_cst_re4e6.description: 436 steady 2-D RANS runs (OpenFOAM v1912 simpleFoam, k-omega SST, y+ < 1, O-grid 228 x 88 = 20k cells, far field 200 chords): 100 Latin-hypercube CST airfoils x 4 angles and NACA 0012/2412/4412/4415 x 9 angles, plus the grid study and XFOIL polars used to verify the solver.
airfoil_rans_cst_re4e6.verification: Grid study on NACA 2412 at alpha 4 deg: coarse/medium/fine 6840/20064/45144 cells, Cl 0.6614/0.6625/0.6624, Cd 0.01112/0.010143/0.009908, Richardson Cd 0.00976, GCI(Cd) 1.9 % with observed order 2.4. XFOIL 6.99 tripped: Cl -2.3 %, Cd +4.5 %. Lift slope 0.110/deg (thin-airfoil 0.110/deg), zero-lift angle -2.00 deg (XFOIL -2.04, thin airfoil -2.08). NACA 0012 at Re 6e6 vs NASA TMR SST: Cd 0.00812 vs 0.0081. Re-runs of 3 cases reproduce Cl/Cd to 2e-5.
airfoil_rans_cst_re4e6.citation: PINNeAPPle contributors (2026). Airfoil RANS campaign (OpenFOAM v1912 simpleFoam, k-omega SST, Re 4e6, 436 runs) and MLP-ensemble surrogate. PINNeAPPle model zoo, https://github.com/PINNeAPPle-Labs/PINNeAPPle

heatsink_forced_convection.title: Plate-fin heat sinks in ducted forced convection (6000 physics-engine solves)
heatsink_forced_convection.description: Latin-hypercube designs (log-uniform) solved by the HeatSink Sizer physics engine.
heatsink_forced_convection.verification: HeatSink Sizer physics engine, checked against independent methods (apps/heatsink_sizer/README.md): FVM spreading vs Lee et al. 1-5 %, forced fin resistance vs Stephan developing-flow Nu + e-NTU 0-5 %, pressure drop vs fully developed friction 2-4 %, natural h vs Elenbaas (1942) 2 %, FVM grid convergence < 2 % (typically 0.1-0.5 %).
heatsink_forced_convection.citation: PINNeAPPle contributors (2026). HeatSink Sizer physics dataset.

rover_contact_grc1_viper.title: Wong-Reece wheel-soil contact forces, GRC-1 simulant, VIPER wheel
rover_contact_grc1_viper.description: Drawbar pull, normal load and torque of the Wong-Reece model over slip x sinkage.
rover_contact_grc1_viper.verification: Analytic model evaluated by adaptive quadrature; Gauss-Legendre (96 nodes) vs scipy quad max relative difference 3e-8. Compared with published single-wheel tests (dataset single_wheel_tests): drawbar-pull RMSE 7.7 N smooth / 4.0 N grousered (Ding 2011), 14.4 / 9.2 N (Wang & Han 2016).
